chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz al-ʿAbdī, from ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who inflicted on a slave a wound reaching the bone, he عليه السلام said: “Upon him is half of one-tenth of his value.”

key_terms.شَجَّ: inflicted a head or facial wound
key_terms.عَبْدًا: a slave; the injured person in this ruling
key_terms.قِيمَتِهِ: his market value, used as the basis of compensation
key_terms.مُوضِحَةً: a wound that exposes the bone

ai.seo_question: What compensation is due if someone inflicts a muḍiḥah wound on a slave?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning compensation for an injury inflicted upon a slave. Imam Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that for a muḍiḥah wound, the liable amount is half of one-tenth of the slave’s value.
